sourceComment: Based on UK Visas and Immigration (UKVI) Standard Visitor guidance. Consular rules change periodically and must always be cross-verified with official GOV.UK sources.

requirements.description: Passport must be valid for the entire duration of your stay in the UK with at least 1 blank page.
requirements.whyRequired: UKVI requires a valid travel document for the whole visit plus clearance for entry and departure.

requirements.description: 6 months or 3 months bank statements showing genuine origin of funds and disposable income.
requirements.whyRequired: UKVI heavily scrutinizes sudden unexplained deposits or insufficient living allowance.

requirements.description: Name alignment across all supporting evidence.
requirements.whyRequired: Discrepancies require legal name change affidavits or cause immediate visa refusal.

requirements.description: Detailed employer letter confirming role, salary, length of service, and authorized holiday.
requirements.whyRequired: Primary proof that the applicant has strong economic roots and will not overstay in the UK.

requirements.description: Declaration of past UK or overseas visa refusals.
requirements.whyRequired: Failing to disclose a prior visa refusal triggers UK immigration rule 320(7A) - 10 year mandatory ban for deception.
